input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the \"Initial Period\").
input.rationale: The Agreement commits Licensee to a 36-month Initial Period (extendable/renewable) but nowhere gives Licensee any right to terminate for convenience: Licensor's termination rights (Articles IV, XIX, XX) are all for breach, insolvency or change of control, and Licensee has no notice-based exit and no refund of prepaid fees. Absence of a Customer convenience right in a term longer than 12 months fails both the preferred and fallback positions, so we insert a 30-day convenience termination right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. Licensor is not given any convenience right today; we state that expressly so the position cannot be read into the renewal mechanics.

mappings.element: Customer may terminate the Agreement or an Order Form for convenience.
Customer's convenience termination requires no more than 30 days' written notice.
Vendor refunds prepaid fees pro rata after Customer's convenience termination.
Vendor has no right to terminate for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee convenience termination on 30 days' notice with pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and bar Licensor convenience termination during the term.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The 36-month term gives us no exit right, so we have added a Licensee right to terminate this Agreement for convenience on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees, and confirmed Licensor has no convenience termination right during the term. If helpful, we can move to 60 days' notice with an early-termination fee capped at three months' fees.

ops.text: Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, in which case Licensor shall refund pro rata any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any renewal or extension term.
